stem: From paragraphs 11 through 13, what can the reader infer about the narrator's relationship with his father?

options.label: A
options.text: The narrator wishes that he could be more like his father.

options.label: B
options.text: The narrator has an instinctive respect for his father.

options.label: C
options.text: The narrator feels conflicted about his father.

options.label: D
options.text: The narrator wants to escape his father's influence.
